org_nodes_account_id_key.name: org_nodes_account_id_key
org_nodes_account_id_key.where: "org_nodes"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "org_nodes"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "org_nodes"."kind" <> 'doctor'

org_nodes_doctor_account_key.where: "org_nodes"."kind" = 'doctor' AND "org_nodes"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "org_nodes"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "org_nodes"."deleted_at" IS NULL

org_nodes_doctor_root_account_key.name: org_nodes_doctor_root_account_key
org_nodes_doctor_root_account_key.where: "org_nodes"."kind" = 'doctor' AND "org_nodes"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "org_nodes"."parent_id" IS NULL AND "org_nodes"."deleted_at" IS NULL

centers_sheba_index_key.name: centers_sheba_index_key
centers_sheba_index_key.where: "centers"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "centers"."sheba_index" IS NOT NULL

doctor_workplaces_branch_key.name: doctor_workplaces_branch_key
doctor_workplaces_branch_key.where: "doctor_workplaces"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "doctor_workplaces"."branch_id" IS NOT NULL

doctors_national_id_index_key.name: doctors_national_id_index_key
doctors_national_id_index_key.where: "doctors"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "doctors"."national_id_index" IS NOT NULL

doctors_account_id_key.name: doctors_account_id_key
doctors_account_id_key.where: "doctors"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "doctors"."account_id" IS NOT NULL

persons_national_id_index_key.name: persons_national_id_index_key
persons_national_id_index_key.where: "persons"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "persons"."national_id_index" IS NOT NULL

proforma_lines_deviation_check.name: proforma_lines_deviation_check
proforma_lines_deviation_check.value: ("proforma_lines"."unit_rial" BETWEEN "proforma_lines"."tariff_min_rial" AND "proforma_lines"."tariff_max_rial") OR "proforma_lines"."deviation_reason" IS NOT NULL

credit_application_assignments_kind_chec.name: credit_application_assignments_kind_check
credit_application_assignments_kind_chec.value:
("credit_application_assignments"."kind" = 'unassigned') = ("credit_application_assignments"."account_id" IS NULL)
          AND ("credit_application_assignments"."kind" <> 'manual' OR "credit_application_assignments"."reason" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("credit_application_assignments"."kind" <> 'auto' OR "credit_application_assignments"."weight_version_id" IS NOT NULL)

credit_applications_amounts_check.name: credit_applications_amounts_check
credit_applications_amounts_check.value:
"credit_applications"."proforma_total_rial" > 0 AND "credit_applications"."down_payment_rial" >= 0 AND "credit_applications"."loan_rial" > 0
          AND "credit_applications"."cash_top_up_rial" >= 0 AND "credit_applications"."plan_fee_rial" >= 0 AND "credit_applications"."origination_fee_rial" >= 0
          AND "credit_applications"."down_payment_rial" + "credit_applications"."loan_rial" + "credit_applications"."cash_top_up_rial" = "credit_applications"."proforma_total_rial"
          AND "credit_applications"."total_obligation_rial" >= "credit_applications"."loan_rial"

credit_decisions_amount_check.name: credit_decisions_amount_check
credit_decisions_amount_check.value:
("credit_decisions"."outcome" IN ('approved', 'conditional')) = ("credit_decisions"."approved_amount_rial" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("credit_decisions"."approved_amount_rial" IS NULL OR "credit_decisions"."approved_amount_rial" > 0)

down_payment_postings_state_check.name: down_payment_postings_state_check
down_payment_postings_state_check.value:
(("down_payment_postings"."funded_purse_id" IS NULL) = ("down_payment_postings"."funded_at" IS NULL))
        AND (("down_payment_postings"."reversal_journal_entry_id" IS NULL) = ("down_payment_postings"."reversed_at" IS NULL))
        AND (("down_payment_postings"."reversal_journal_entry_id" IS NULL) = ("down_payment_postings"."reversal_reason" IS NULL))
        AND (("down_payment_postings"."reversal_journal_entry_id" IS NULL) = ("down_payment_postings"."reversed_by" IS NULL))
        AND ("down_payment_postings"."funded_purse_id" IS NULL OR "down_payment_postings"."reversal_journal_entry_id" IS NULL)

instruments_item_key.name: instruments_item_key
instruments_item_key.where: "instruments"."item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "instruments"."deleted_at" IS NULL
